items.prompt: I ___ home when I met my old teacher in the street.
items.explain: Uzoq jarayon (yurish) — Continuous, uni to'xtatgan qisqa voqea (met) — Simple. I bilan was, were emas.

items.prompt: While Aziz ___ breakfast, the phone rang.
items.explain: While jarayon bilan ishlatiladi: was making. Qisqa voqea (rang) — Past Simple.

items.prompt: When I opened the door, the children ___ on the sofa.
items.explain: Eshikni ochgan paytda bolalar uxlab yotgan edi (jarayon). Children ko'plik: were.

items.prompt: He ___ a shower when the electricity went off.
items.explain: Dush qabul qilish jarayonini elektr o'chishi to'xtatdi: was taking + went off.

items.prompt: She ___ the exam, then she went to a cafe with her friends.
items.explain: Ketma-ket tugagan ishlar: finished, then went. Continuous bu yerda mos emas.

items.prompt: I ___ a letter when my sister came into the room.
items.explain: Yozish jarayonini opa kirishi to'xtatdi: was writing. Was dan keyin -ing kerak, 3-shakl emas.

items.prompt: The film started and everybody ___ quiet.
items.explain: Film boshlandi va hamma jim bo'lib qoldi — ketma-ket voqea, Past Simple.

items.prompt: While I ___ in London, I visited many museums.
items.explain: While + jarayon: yashab turganimda. Bu davrda qisqa voqea (visited) sodir bo'ldi.

items.prompt: What ___ when the lights went out?
items.explain: Chiroq o'chgan paytdagi jarayon so'ralyapti: What were you doing? You bilan was ishlatilmaydi, savolda esa ega yordamchi fe'ldan keyin turadi.

items.prompt: We ___ along the river when we saw a beautiful bird.
items.explain: Daryo bo'ylab yurib borayotganimizda qush ko'rdik: were walking (jarayon) + saw (qisqa).

items.prompt: Yesterday Dilnoza got up, ___ her teeth and left the house.
items.explain: Ketma-ket qisqa harakatlar zanjiri: got up, brushed, left — hammasi Past Simple.

items.prompt: I didn't see the sign because I ___ on the phone while I was driving.
items.explain: Ikkita parallel jarayon: was driving va was talking. Sabab doimiy fon bo'lganligi uchun Continuous.

theory.def: Ikki zamon birga: Past Continuous — davom etayotgan UZUN ish, Past Simple — uni bo'lgan yoki shu paytda yuz bergan QISQA voqea.
uses: I was cooking when the phone rang.
Ikki ish bir vaqtda davom etadi
While I was cooking, he was reading.
The phone rang and I answered it.
forms: S + was / were + V-ing + when + Past Simple
We were walking when it started to rain.
While she was singing, he was dancing.
He came in and sat down.
theory.tip: when — «shu payt», while — «-ayotganda».
rules: while dan keyin odatda Continuous keladi.
when I arrived, he was eating — kelganimda ovqatlanayotgan edi.
when I arrived, he ate — kelganimdan keyin ovqatlandi.
Gap while / when bilan boshlansa, vergul qo'yiladi.
ex: I saw an accident while I was waiting.
When you called, I was having a shower.
Qo'ng'iroq qilganingda dush qabul qilayotgan edim.
She fell while she was running.
err: While I cooked, the phone was ringing.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.

title: used to · tuzoqli test

items.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ play outside until it got dark every evening.
items.explain: Oldingi odat: used to + fe'l. 'am used to' esa 'ko'nikkanman' degan boshqa ma'no beradi va -ing bilan ishlatiladi.

items.prompt: A: Did you ___ live in a small village? B: Yes, I did. I loved it.
items.explain: Savol va inkorda did bor, shuning uchun used emas, use to: Did you use to...?

items.prompt: My grandfather ___ smoke, but he stopped ten years ago.
items.explain: Oldin chekardi, endi yo'q: used to + smoke. 'uses to' shakli yo'q.

items.prompt: We ___ have a big dog, but now we have only a cat.
items.explain: Oldingi holat: used to have. Hozir endi yo'q.

items.prompt: I never ___ like spicy food, but now I eat it every day.
items.explain: Inkor: I never used to / I didn't use to like. Hozir o'zgargan.

items.prompt: Tashkent ___ be much smaller, with many old houses and few tall buildings.
items.explain: Shaharning oldingi holati: used to be. 'is used to' bu yerda mutlaqo boshqa ma'no.

items.prompt: I didn't ___ wake up early, but now I get up at five.
items.explain: Did / didn't dan keyin used emas, use to ishlatiladi: I didn't use to wake up early.

items.prompt: When he was young, he ___ to school by bike every day.
items.explain: Used to + asosiy fe'l (go), -ing emas.

items.prompt: She ___ be shy, but now she loves speaking in public.
items.explain: Shaxsiyatdagi o'zgarish: used to be shy. 'Used to' hamma shaxsga bir xil.

items.prompt: A: ___ you use to play the piano? B: Yes, but I stopped when I was twelve.
items.explain: Used to savoli did bilan quriladi: Did you use to...? 'Used you to' juda eskirgan.

items.prompt: My parents ___ travel every summer, but they stay at home now.
items.explain: Takroriy oldingi odat: used to travel. Hozir bu odat yo'q.

items.prompt: There ___ be a cinema on this street, but it closed in 2015.
items.explain: Oldin bor edi, hozir yo'q: There used to be... 'is used to' to'g'ri emas.

theory.def: used to — o'tmishda muntazam bo'lgan, lekin HOZIR YO'Q odat yoki holat: «ilgari …ar edim».
uses: There used to be a cinema here.
Did you use to live there?
forms: She used to have long hair.
I didn't use to like milk.
theory.tip: used to = «oldin shunday edi, endi unday emas».
rules: did bor joyda use (d harfisiz).
Hozirgi odat uchun used to emas, usually.
Bir marta bo'lgan ish uchun Past Simple.
ex: My father used to walk to work.
I didn't use to drink coffee, but now I do.
This used to be a quiet street.
err: I use to play when I was five.
I used to play when I was five.

Did you use to go there?

theory.def: Ikkinchi fe'l qanday shaklda kelishi birinchi fe'lga bog'liq: ba'zilaridan keyin -ing, ba'zilaridan keyin to + V1 keladi.
forms: enjoy / like / love / hate / finish / stop / mind / keep + V-ing
want / need / decide / hope / plan / learn / promise + to + V1
theory.tip: Kelajakka qarasa (want, hope, plan) — to. Zavq yoki tajriba (enjoy, hate) — -ing.
rules: like va love dan keyin to ham bo'ladi, farqi kichik.
would like / would love dan keyin faqat to.
look forward to dan keyin -ing.
